nextAction.label: Public Site And Contact Inputs

blockedChecks.label: CODY_SITE_URL is a real HTTPS URL
blockedChecks.action: Set CODY_SITE_URL to the final public site origin, then rebuild the site, archive, packet, and manifest.

blockedChecks.label: CODY_SUPPORT_EMAIL is real
blockedChecks.action: Set CODY_SUPPORT_EMAIL to the public support contact that will appear on support/privacy pages.

blockedChecks.label: App Review contact name is real
blockedChecks.action: Set CODY_REVIEW_CONTACT_NAME for App Store Connect App Review contact information.

blockedChecks.label: App Review contact email is real
blockedChecks.action: Set CODY_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL for App Store Connect App Review contact information.

blockedChecks.label: App Review contact phone is real
blockedChecks.action: Set CODY_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE for App Store Connect App Review contact information.

blockedChecks.label: Generated App Store fields have HTTPS support/privacy URLs
blockedChecks.action: Run npm run packet:store after real CODY_SITE_URL is available.

blockedChecks.label: Generated public site has no raw placeholder tokens
blockedChecks.action: Set real CODY_* values, then run npm run site:store.
blockedChecks.evidence: raw placeholder token remains in generated public site

blockedChecks.label: Generated public site has publish-ready contact and origin
blockedChecks.action: Set real CODY_SITE_URL and CODY_SUPPORT_EMAIL, then run npm run site:store.

blockedChecks.label: Public site archive has no publish placeholders
blockedChecks.action: Run npm run site:archive after generating the site with real public values.

blockedChecks.label: MAS signing assets are installed
blockedChecks.action: Install Apple Distribution/Mac App Distribution plus Mac Installer Distribution identities and a matching macOS/Mac App Store provisioning profile, then run npm run check:mas-signing -- --strict.

blockedChecks.label: Signed MAS package boundary passes
blockedChecks.action: Run npm run dist:mas on the signed release machine, then npm run check:mas-package -- --strict to verify the app bundle, signed current-version installer package, signature, embedded provisioning profile, and MAS entitlements.

blockedChecks.label: Generated public release values are synced
blockedChecks.action: Set real CODY_* values, then run npm run site:store, npm run site:archive, npm run packet:store, npm run review-brief:store, npm run copy-map:store, and npm run check:public-release-sync -- --strict.

blockedChecks.label: App Store upload tooling and MAS package are available
blockedChecks.action: Install Transporter from the Mac App Store or full Xcode command-line upload tools, run npm run dist:mas, verify the signed current-version package with npm run check:mas-package -- --strict, then run npm run check:upload-tooling -- --strict.

blockedChecks.label: App Store Connect upload credentials are configured
blockedChecks.action: Run npm run install:asc-key -- --key-id <asc-key-id> --issuer-id <asc-issuer-id> --file /path/to/AuthKey_<key-id>.p8 --dry-run, install the key outside the project if validation passes, export ASC_KEY_ID and ASC_ISSUER_ID, then run npm run check:upload-credentials -- --strict.

blockedChecks.label: Public URL reachability gate is ready to run
blockedChecks.action: After publishing the public site, run npm run check:store-urls -- --strict.

blockedChecks.label: Published public-site pages match the generated source
blockedChecks.action: After publishing the public site, run npm run check:published-site -- --strict.

blockedChecks.label: Generated App Store Connect copy has no placeholder contact data
blockedChecks.action: Run npm run packet:store after real public support and App Review contact values are set.
